title: psrnn: physics-structured recurrent networks for open sorption heat stores
description: Python package (PyTorch) that estimates the state of charge and the heat power of an open packed-bed sorption heat store from its inlet and outlet air measurements. The bed is split into slices whose transitions are exact water and energy balances; the isotherm (Toth, Langmuir or Dubinin-Astakhov), the transfer units and the heat losses are learnt. The package trains with or without state-of-charge labels, estimates the initial state of a phase from its first hours of measurements, and gives conformal prediction intervals. Examples: the full-scale STAID zeolite 13X store and a laboratory silica gel bed.
